title: Newmark Facilitates Full Lease-Up of Newly Developed Industrial Building in Des Moines, Washington
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the full lease-up of Des Moines Creek Business Park West, a newly developed 405,680-square-foot industrial facility at 1800 S. 216th Street in Des Moines, Washington.
